nodes.description: IAddressResolver state variable holding the address resolver proxy; assigned once in the constructor.
Constant bytes32 key "PeriFinance" used to look up the PeriFinance contract address.
Constant bytes32 key "ExchangeRates" used to look up the ExchangeRates contract address.
Constant bytes32 key "pUSD" used as the destination currency key for value conversion.
constructor(address resolver) — stores IAddressResolver(resolver) into addressResolverProxy.
internal view helper resolving the PeriFinance contract via addressResolverProxy.requireAndGetAddress(CONTRACT_PERIFINANCE).
internal view helper resolving the ExchangeRates contract via addressResolverProxy.requireAndGetAddress(CONTRACT_EXRATES).
external view totalPynthsInKey(address account, bytes32 currencyKey) returns (uint total) — loops over all pynths and accumulates converted balance values.
external view pynthsBalances(address account) — returns currency keys, raw balances and pUSD balances for an account.
external view frozenPynths() — returns the currency keys whose rates are frozen.
external view pynthsRates() — returns all available currency keys and their rates.
external view pynthsTotalSupplies() — returns currency keys, total supplies and pUSD-converted total supplies.
address account parameter of totalPynthsInKey, used as the balanceOf look-up subject.
bytes32 currencyKey parameter of totalPynthsInKey, used as the destination key of effectiveValue.
address resolver parameter of the constructor, stored into addressResolverProxy.
address account parameter of pynthsBalances, used for balanceOf and value conversion.
local uint total accumulator in totalPynthsInKey, updated with an unchecked +=.
local uint numPynths in totalPynthsInKey, taken from periFinance.availablePynthCount() and used as loop bound.
local IPeriFinance instance in totalPynthsInKey returned by _periFinance().
local IExchangeRates instance in totalPynthsInKey returned by _exchangeRates().
local IPynth instance created per loop iteration in totalPynthsInKey.
total += exchangeRates.effectiveValue(...) — unchecked arithmetic accumulation over an externally sized set of pynths.
for (i = 0; i < numPynths; i++) — loop bound comes from an external contract (availablePynthCount), enabling unbounded gas consumption.
local bytes32[] currencyKeys array allocated and filled in pynthsBalances.
local uint[] balances array allocated and filled in pynthsBalances.

edges.reason: constructor parameter resolver flows into contract initialization.
constructor writes addressResolverProxy state variable.
_periFinance reads addressResolverProxy to resolve the PeriFinance address.
_periFinance uses the CONTRACT_PERIFINANCE constant as the lookup name.
_exchangeRates reads addressResolverProxy to resolve the ExchangeRates address.
_exchangeRates uses the CONTRACT_EXRATES constant as the lookup name.
totalPynthsInKey invokes the internal helper _periFinance().
totalPynthsInKey invokes the internal helper _exchangeRates().
External view call into the resolved PeriFinance contract via the resolver proxy.
External view call into the resolved ExchangeRates contract (effectiveValue).
account parameter drives IERC20.balanceOf look-ups inside the loop.
currencyKey parameter is the destination key passed to effectiveValue.
Account-dependent balance values feed the unchecked accumulator total.
currencyKey influences the converted value added to the accumulator.
numPynths assigned from periFinance.availablePynthCount().
numPynths is the loop bound of the unbounded iteration operation.
local IPeriFinance instance returned by _periFinance() is used throughout totalPynthsInKey.
local IExchangeRates instance returned by _exchangeRates() is used in totalPynthsInKey.
local IPynth instance is created per iteration and read inside totalPynthsInKey.
local total variable is the operand updated by the unchecked += accumulation.
Accumulated total is returned by totalPynthsInKey.
pynthsBalances invokes the internal helper _periFinance().
pynthsBalances invokes the internal helper _exchangeRates().
External view call into the resolved PeriFinance contract.
External view call into the resolved ExchangeRates contract.
account parameter is used for balanceOf and effectiveValue conversions.
PUSD constant is used as the destination currency key in effectiveValue.
currencyKeys array is allocated, filled and returned by pynthsBalances.
balances array is allocated, filled and returned by pynthsBalances.
frozenPynths invokes the internal helper _periFinance().
frozenPynths invokes the internal helper _exchangeRates().
External view call into the resolved PeriFinance contract.
External view call into the resolved ExchangeRates contract (rateIsFrozen).
pynthsRates invokes the internal helper _periFinance().
pynthsRates invokes the internal helper _exchangeRates().
External view call into the resolved PeriFinance contract (availableCurrencyKeys).
External view call into the resolved ExchangeRates contract (ratesForCurrencies).
pynthsTotalSupplies invokes the internal helper _periFinance().
pynthsTotalSupplies invokes the internal helper _exchangeRates().
External view call into the resolved PeriFinance contract.
External view call into the resolved ExchangeRates contract.
PUSD constant is used as the destination currency key for total supply conversion.
The IPeriFinance instance returned by _periFinance() flows back into totalPynthsInKey.
The IExchangeRates instance returned by _exchangeRates() flows back into totalPynthsInKey.
The IPeriFinance instance returned by _periFinance() flows back into pynthsBalances.
The IExchangeRates instance returned by _exchangeRates() flows back into pynthsBalances.
